en: The postcard consists of two sides. One side shows old handwritten Swedish text, an address, and a Swedish stamp with a postmark dated 1902. The other side features a historical winter scene in black and white of a broad street lined with ornate multi-story European buildings, lamp posts, and snow. At the bottom, text reads 'Esplanadgatan i Vinterskrud' (Esplanade Street in winter attire) and 'Sundsvall', indicating a city in Sweden.
